downstream.basis: 47 running downstream instances from scoped inventory. Historical saved scheduler accounting matched these request totals; missing init requests treated zero only in scheduler arithmetic.
downstream.limitations: Not finite enforced limits; downstream excess (including OVN proxy) excluded from this fixed economic charge. No auto-discovery or unknown downstream inclusion.

excludedInstrumentation.reason: Benchmark instrumentation excluded from offering economics, reported separately.

inventory.basis: Validated scoped quiet inventory;97 running controlled instances,6020m/14016Mi source weights;92 selectors. Source paths/hashes are audit receipts, not private runtime dependencies.
inventory.limitations: Saved benchmark Pod layouts only, not full startup concurrency, completed Jobs, absent workloads, changed replicas, rollout surge or actual admission. Missing observations remain explicit.

node.basis: Linux Consumption on-demand retail, primary meter; not Spot, Low Priority, Windows or reservation

quota.basis: Saved2026-09-11 startup sample:24 matched containers and17 Pod parents; all matched quantum model. Extrapolated to benchmark52Pods. Runtime origin/deployed source unverified; not universal Kubernetes behavior.
